name: verdandi-preregistration
reading: a fork of executable-epistemics' registry: a rung that will produce a number on a host registers its hypothesis, success condition, failure condition and interpretation limits HERE, before its instrument runs; the entry's chain hash is what the rung's record must cite; an entry without a failure condition is refused a seat

RECORD-0.hypothesis: every record Verðandi mints can be written by two languages and read through one firewall without a verdict entering data
RECORD-0.success_condition: records-firewall PASSES over every committed record; records-twins shows Python recomputes the chain hash of every Rust-written record; a planted verdict key and a planted tampered hash are both refused by BOTH readers
RECORD-0.failure_condition: any committed record lacks a field, carries a verdict-shaped key, or has a chain hash the other language cannot reproduce; or a plant passes either reader
interpretation_limits: a chain hash detects tampering after sealing; it does not make the data true — `check` and the rows do that
the firewall scans keys, not meaning: a verdict can still be smuggled as a value or a string, and is caught only by reading

SHELL-0.hypothesis: a hand-rolled Win32 shell (zero crates) can blit the kernel's composite into a window, prove it blitted what the kernel made, and time frame-ready -> composited on the owner's host
SHELL-0.success_condition: the blit-hash law holds headless (a byte altered between kernel and blit reddens; the plant bites); on the host, N frames blitted with every blit hash equal to the kernel's composite sha, and a record of frame-ready -> composited p50/p95/p99/max µs with DwmGetCompositionTimingInfo's refresh period beside it, sealed under the envelope with the budgets as data
SHELL-0.failure_condition: a blit whose hash differs from the kernel's composite goes unrefused; or no composited timestamp can be read from DWM on the host; or the record cannot be sealed without a verdict-shaped key; or the number is not reproducible in shape (order of magnitude) on a second run
interpretation_limits: frame-ready -> composited is not input-to-photon: input transport, the present wait beyond composition and the panel need capture hardware
a composed GDI present costs at least one refresh interval under DWM (documented); this number is a BASELINE for a later flip-model shell, not a claim of low latency
Windows-only; a second shell is a later rung
SHELL-0.instrument: shell/win32.rs + verify rows shell-blit-hash, shell-blit-plant; off-gate: shell --measure N on the host -> shell/attest/present-<host>.json

LATENCY-0.hypothesis: for the fixed sealed playback sequence, the host's frame-ready -> composited present path fits one 144Hz frame period (SOFTWARE-144-BUDGET) AND the panel refreshes at >=144Hz (HARDWARE-144), each measured and reported independently; SUSTAINED-144Hz is their conjunction (A AND B), never the software budget alone
LATENCY-0.success_condition: on the host, replaying the sealed reference session through shell playback-window --measure, a record of per-frame frame-ready -> composited p50/p95/p99/max us with the measured panel refresh period beside it, sealed under the envelope; SOFTWARE-144-BUDGET is PASS iff p99 <= 6944 us; HARDWARE-144 is PASS iff the measured refresh period <= 6944 us (>=144 Hz); SUSTAINED-144Hz = SOFTWARE-144-BUDGET AND HARDWARE-144
LATENCY-0.failure_condition: p99(frame-ready -> composited) > 6944 us fails SOFTWARE-144-BUDGET; a measured refresh period > 6944 us fails HARDWARE-144; either alone refutes SUSTAINED-144Hz; also fails if no composited timestamp can be read from DWM on the host, the record carries a verdict-shaped key, or the shape (order of magnitude) is not reproducible on a second run
interpretation_limits: SOFTWARE-144-BUDGET is a BUDGET condition: 99% of frame-ready -> composited intervals fit the nominal 144Hz period (6944 us). It is NOT by itself sustained-144Hz presentation and it is NOT a refresh-rate claim
HARDWARE-144 is MEASURED from the DwmFlush interval, never inferred from the monitor's nominal setting

frame-ready -> composited excludes the kernel render (that is the bench), input transport, the present wait beyond composition, and the panel scan-out; it is NOT input-to-photon (that needs capture hardware)
the wait after composition is an instrument limitation of a composed GDI present; a flip-model / waitable-swapchain path is a later rung
the sequence is the fixed sealed reference session, not arbitrary interactive load; Windows-only
LATENCY-0.instrument: shell/win32.rs playback_window --measure N (off-gate, host, --cfg shell_window) -> a raw record sealed by verify/seal_latency.py -> shell/attest/latency-<host>.json, citing this entry; verify row latency-preregistered locks this method

GAUNTLET-0.hypothesis: the reference render (strips + frame + emit) decomposes at the kernel's pub-phase boundaries; the render phase with the largest p99 render-share, IF >= 500 permille, is GAUNTLET-1's optimization target; the witness hashes (frame_digest, pixel_sha) are a verification-only cost the interactive render never pays and are reported separately; the floor cast lives inside frame() and is separable only by GAUNTLET-1's sibling renderer
GAUNTLET-0.success_condition: a host breakdown record reports per-phase p50/p95/p99/max us and each render phase's p99 render-share in permille, witnesses checked against the frozen corpus BEFORE any number; GAUNTLET-1 is seated ONLY against a render phase whose p99 share >= 500 permille, and GAUNTLET-1 must prove byte-identical output against the frozen reference (a differential oracle: frame_digest AND pixel_sha equal over the corpus plus adversarial cameras) BEFORE any speed claim
GAUNTLET-0.failure_condition: no render phase reaches 500 permille (no single-phase optimization is justified; the 'incremental floor cast' hypothesis specifically dies unless frame() >= 500 permille); or the phase times do not reconcile with the render total; or the shape is not reproducible on a second run; or the breakdown rendered anything other than the frozen witnesses
interpretation_limits: host-CPU-specific absolute times; the p99 render-share (permille) is the portable quantity, not the microseconds
coarse pub-phase granularity: floor-vs-walls inside frame(), and any sub-emit split, need GAUNTLET-1's sibling renderer, which then carries the differential byte-identity oracle
mantle.rs is NOT modified; GAUNTLET-0 only times the existing pub calls
the witness hashes (frame_digest, pixel_sha) are verification cost, NOT interactive-render cost; the render total excludes them
a breakdown is a target-finder, not a speed improvement; no optimization is claimed by GAUNTLET-0; not a claim about any other scene, tile set or resolution
GAUNTLET-0.instrument: kernel/main.rs --breakdown N (off-gate, host) via verify/gauntlet.py -> kernel/attest/breakdown-<host>.json, citing this entry; verify row gauntlet-preregistered locks this method and the 500-permille decision rule

GAUNTLET-1.hypothesis: emit is GAUNTLET-1's target (from GAUNTLET-0). A candidate emit is ACCEPTED as a renderer iff it is byte-identical to the frozen mantle.rs emit (pixel_sha) with an unchanged frame (frame_digest) over the corpus PLUS adversarial cameras; correctness is mandatory and independent of speed. A candidate is PROMOTED to the fast path iff it is accepted AND measurably faster on ONE consistent apparatus; identical-but-slower is a correctness pass and a performance fail; different pixels is not a renderer at any speed
GAUNTLET-1.success_condition: gauntlet1-equiv PASSES (fast_pixels == pixels and fast_frame == frame over every corpus and adversarial case); gauntlet1-region names the dominant divide-work region deterministically; and a promotion is claimed only with byte-identity AND a same-apparatus host speed measurement (witnesses checked first) against a stated threshold, sealed off-gate as GAUNTLET-1b citing this entry
GAUNTLET-1.failure_condition: any case where fast_equal != OK, or fast_pixels != pixels, or fast_frame != frame, refuses the candidate as a renderer regardless of speed; a promotion claimed without byte-identity, or without a same-apparatus speed measurement, or by comparing against GAUNTLET-0's instrumented render absolute; or mantle.rs is modified (the reference must stay frozen)
interpretation_limits: mantle.rs is the frozen correctness oracle: the differential compares candidate -> frozen, never the reverse, and the harness is not the oracle; the candidate is guilty until its bytes agree
correctness (byte-identity) and performance (speed) are two SEPARATE courts; byte-identity is mandatory and gate-enforced, speed is judged independently off-gate
the region measure is divide-work (a source-derived proxy: ceiling 0, wall 1, floor 4 integer divisions per pixel), NOT a wall-clock; it names a target, it is not a speedup
a GAUNTLET-1b speed number is host-specific and is NEVER compared to GAUNTLET-0's instrumented render absolute (different apparatus); it is a same-apparatus frozen-vs-candidate delta
GAUNTLET-1a commits NO optimization technique; the seed fast.rs is an exact transcription that only proves the harness
GAUNTLET-1.instrument: kernel/main.rs --fast (gate rows gauntlet1-equiv, gauntlet1-region) for correctness + the deterministic region measure; the host speed number is GAUNTLET-1b's, off-gate, sealed and citing this entry; row gauntlet1-preregistered locks this method and the two-court promotion rule

RE-BREAKDOWN-1.hypothesis: After GAUNTLET-1c the emit cost structure shifted (a 536x floor divide cut bought ~12% wall-clock), so the next step is to MEASURE, not optimize. emit's internal cost is attributed two ways: Court A, a DETERMINISTIC structural measure (gate-enforced, wall-clock-free) of what work exists; and Court B, a host ablation of fenced probes (addr -> lookup -> full) timed against emit. The probes are MEASUREMENT APPARATUS, NOT candidate renderers: a probe may be wrong by construction provided its wrongness is isolated from the certified path and its work is a demonstrable subset of that path (proven by probe VERIFY == emit, byte-identical).
RE-BREAKDOWN-1.success_condition: Court A passes on gate: emitbd_verify OK (the probe VERIFY path is byte-identical to emit and the frozen witness), write coverage is exactly once over every framebuffer pixel, and the memory reads are 3 per textured pixel; the working-set cardinality and the floor texel-stride locality are reported as data. Court B is a same-apparatus host ablation sealed off-gate as verdandi-emit-breakdown citing this entry, with the deltas read as incremental attribution.
RE-BREAKDOWN-1.failure_condition: probe VERIFY != emit (the apparatus is not a subset of the certified path); or the production emit or emit_collapse calls a probe (the fence is breached); or a Court B delta is interpreted as a pure hardware-resource cost rather than an incremental ablation delta; or any optimization is committed on this rung before the number (RE-BREAKDOWN-1 measures, it does not optimize); or a Court B number is compared to GAUNTLET-0's instrumented render absolute.
interpretation_limits: RE-BREAKDOWN-1 MEASURES, it does not optimize: no candidate renderer is committed on this rung
Court A and Court B are two separate courts; Court A is a source-derived proxy for time (deterministic, gate-enforced), Court B is the wall-clock (host, off-gate)

the Court B deltas (LOOKUP-ADDR, FULL-LOOKUP) are incremental wall-clock attribution under controlled ablation, NOT pure hardware-resource measurements; cache state, branches, scheduling and register pressure make the subtraction non-additive; the experiment possesses no architectural counters
the probes are measurement apparatus, not renderers: they never enter fast.rs's promotion chain, the production emit calls none of them, and a differing probe pixel is expected, not a fault
a Court B number is host-specific and is NEVER compared to GAUNTLET-0's instrumented render absolute (different apparatus)

the promotion rule is locked before any result: lookup increment or pathological locality -> LOCK a data-layout/locality court; address/DDA -> arithmetic path; full-write -> framebuffer path; results disagree or nothing dominates -> DEFER, do not optimize by intuition
RE-BREAKDOWN-1.instrument: kernel/main.rs --emit-structure (deterministic Court A; gate rows rebreakdown1-structure, rebreakdown1-fence) and --emit-breakdown N (Court A + the host ablation ladder); kernel/fast.rs::probe is the fenced apparatus (emit_probe<MODE>, black_box-anchored, VERIFY == emit); the host number is sealed by verify/rebreakdown1.py citing this entry; row rebreakdown1-preregistered locks this method and the promotion table.
